summary: RemoveMacAI is a shell script that disables Apple Intelligence services on macOS 27, freeing disk space. It runs locally via a simple CLI without requiring any API keys. It is most useful for privacy‑concerned macOS users who want to reclaim storage without installing heavyweight software. The project gained rapid attention (1,126 stars in 6 days) but only 33% of its tests pass and it lacks integration hooks, limiting its reliability for production use.
